analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free occurs during teardown due to destruction-order bug: BlockData destruction releases its shared_ptr<SymbolTable> (freeing Variable objects) before all IR expression nodes/VariableReference nodes in that block are destroyed. Later, VariableReference::~VariableReference calls Variable::referenceDestroyed on a freed Variable, causing UAF (crash observed in SkSLVariable.h:123-128).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In sksl2spirv, attacker-controlled shader text is parsed into IR with local variables and outstanding VariableReference nodes in statements/expressions. On program destruction (Compiler::convertProgram cleanup path), BlockData cleanup drops symbol tables early; if VariableReference objects still exist in IR subtree, their destructors run afterward and dereference freed Variable pointers. The provided PoC creates function-local arrays/uses that leave such references alive until teardown, triggering the UAF.
